.. _X_427:

X_427
=====

.. rubric:: COMPLEMENT OF X_22

.. enunciation::

   :ref:`X_427 <X_427>` is the :term:`complement <complement>` of :ref:`X_22 <X_22>`.

.. figure:: x-00427.svg
   :alt: X_427 — COMPLEMENT OF X_22
   :align: center

   **X_427** (*COMPLEMENT OF X_22*) constructed on acute reference triangle :math:`(a, b, c) = (5, 6, 7)` with unit baseline :g:`AB <[ A B ]>` = :math:`1`.

.. admonition:: Constructed Elements
   :class: note

   * **Derived Triangle:** :term:`Medial Triangle <medial triangle>` :g:`△M_aM_bM_c << M_a M_b M_c >>` — vertices :g:`M_a <M_a>`, :g:`M_b <M_b>`, :g:`M_c <M_c>` (Formed by the midpoints of sides BC, CA, AB)
   * **Central Lines:** :g:`{2, 22} <{ 2, 22 }>`, :g:`{2, 3} <{ 2, 3 }>` (:term:`Euler line <euler line>`)
   * **Related Centers:** :g:`X_2 <X_2>` (:ref:`CENTROID <X_2>`), :g:`X_22 <X_22>` (:ref:`EXETER POINT <X_22>`), :g:`X_3 <X_3>` (:ref:`CIRCUMCENTER <X_3>`)

.. signature:: center

   | **Trilinears:** :math:`\sec A + \cos(B - C)`
   | **Barycentrics:** :math:`\tan A + \tan \omega : :`
   | **Search Value (6, 9, 13):** :math:`16.125778007218`

.. collapse:: Alternate Coordinates
   :badge: 1 form

   * **Barycentrics:** :math:`(a^{2} + b^{2} - c^{2}) \cdot (a^{2} - b^{2} + c^{2}) \cdot (b^{2} + c^{2}) : :`

   :badge: 1 combination

   * :ref:`X_427 <X_427>` = :math:`3` :ref:`X_2 <X_2>` + X_7391, :math:`9` :ref:`X_2 <X_2>` - X_20062, :ref:`X_2 <X_2>` + :math:`3` X_31105, :math:`3` :ref:`X_2 <X_2>` - :math:`5` X_31236, :math:`5` :ref:`X_2 <X_2>` - :math:`3` X_47596, :math:`3` :ref:`X_4 <X_4>` - X_35480, :math:`3` :ref:`X_4 <X_4>` + X_35481, :math:`3` :ref:`X_5 <X_5>` - :math:`4` X_13413, and many others

{47612, 47613, 11585}, {52286, 52287, :ref:`460 <X_460>`}, {52293, 52297, :ref:`2 <X_2>`}

Notes
-----

.. container:: note-item

   As a point on the Euler line, :ref:`X_427 <X_427>` has Shinagawa coefficients :math:`(F,E + F)`.

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`L_{A} <L_A>` be the line tangent to the nine-point circle at the midpoint of segment :g:`BC <[ B C ]>`, and define :g:`L_{B} <L_B>` and :g:`L_{C} <L_C>` cyclically. The triangle formed by the lines :g:`L_{A} <L_A>`, :g:`L_{B} <L_B>`, :g:`L_{C} <L_C>` is homothetic to the orthic triangle, and the center of homothety is :ref:`X_427 <X_427>`. (:person:`Randy Hutson <randy-hutson>`, 9/23/2011)

.. container:: note-item

   Let (O) be the circumcircle, (N) the nine-point circle, and (:g:`I_{A} <I_A>`, (:g:`I_{B} <I_B>`, (:g:`I_{C} <I_C>` the excircles of :g:`ABC << A B C >>`. Let :g:`A' <A'>` and :g:`A″ <A″>` be the points of intersection of (O) and (:g:`I_{A} <I_A>`. Let :g:`F_{A} <F_A>` be the touchpoint of (N) and (:g:`I_{A} <I_A>`, and let (:g:`K_{A} <K_A>`) be the circle through :g:`A' <A'>` and :g:`A″ <A″>` that is internally tangent to (N); let :g:`L_{A} <L_A>` be the touchpoint. Define :g:`F_{B} <F_B>`, :g:`F_{C} <F_C>` and :g:`L_{B} <L_B>`, :g:`L_{C} <L_C>` cyclically. The lines :g:`F_{A}L_{A} <[ F_A L_A ]>`, :g:`F_{B}L_{B} <[ F_B L_B ]>`, :g:`F_{C}L_{C} <[ F_C L_C ]>` concur ion :ref:`X_427 <X_427>`. (Tran Quang Hung :cite:`ADGEOM #1458 <adgeom>`, August 5, 2014; see also #1459)

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`Cm_aCm_bCm_c << Cm_a Cm_b Cm_c >>` be the :term:`circummedial triangle <circummedial-triangle>`. Let :g:`A″ <A″>` be the pole, wrt the polar circle, of line :g:`Cm_bCm_c <[ Cm_b Cm_c ]>`, and define :g:`B″ <B″>` and :g:`C″ <C″>` cyclically. The lines :g:`AA″ <[ A A″ ]>`, :g:`BB″ <[ B B″ ]>`, :g:`CC″ <[ C C″ ]>` concur in :ref:`X_427 <X_427>`. Moreover, :ref:`X_427 <X_427>` is the Euler line intercept of radical axis of nine-point circle and every circle with center on orthic axis that is orthogonal to nine-point circle, and :ref:`X_427 <X_427>` is the point in which the extended trapezoid legs (P(4),P(4)-Ceva conjugate of U(4)) and (U(4),U(4)-Ceva conjugate of P(4)) meet. Also, :ref:`X_427 <X_427>` is the :g:`QA <[ Q A ]>`-P38 center (Montesdeoca-Hutson Point) of quadrangle :g:`ABC << A B C >>`\ :ref:`X_2 <X_2>`. (Randy Hutson, October 13, 2015)

.. container:: note-item

   :ref:`X_427 <X_427>` is the homothetic center of any pair of the following: polar triangle of nine-point circle, orthic axes triangle (see :ref:`X_2501 <X_2501>`), Yiu tangents triangle (see X_7495). (Randy Hutson, August 19, 2019)
